data.one_liner: Provides the free Font Awesome icon pack as Flutter widgets.
data.what_it_does: Adds over 2000 free Font Awesome icons as ready‑to‑use Flutter Icon widgets. Icons are generated from the Font Awesome OTF files and can be referenced via the FaIcon widget and FontAwesomeIcons class.
use_when: You need a large collection of ready‑made icons
You want to match Font Awesome designs used on the web
You prefer compile‑time generated icon constants
avoid_when: You require only the Pro icon set
You need icons that work with the standard Icon widget without a wrapper
App size is a critical constraint
strengths: Simple API with FaIcon and FontAwesomeIcons
weaknesses: Breaking changes require FaIconData instead of IconData
Standard Icon widget cannot be used with these icons
Tree‑shaking may be limited, increasing app size
data.setup_notes: Add font_awesome_flutter to pubspec dependencies and import the package
